financials_interim.notes: Company-basis (standalone parent, holding-company level -- no operating subsidiaries consolidated) column of the same filing; Net Revenue at this level is almost entirely dividend/other income driven rather than manufacturing turnover (Other Operating Income of 940,583 vs Gross Profit of 2,032,232 reflects large dividend income of 759,295 from subsidiaries per the cash flow statement). operating_profit derived the same way as Group (Gross Profit + Other Operating Income - Distribution Expenses - Administrative Expenses + Other Operating Expenses = 2,032,232+940,583-1,176,644-322,891+7,324=1,480,604; small ~259 rounding gap vs the exact tie computed from Finance items: 1,418,292 stated PBT + 97,747 finance costs - 35,435 finance income = 1,480,604, used as operating_profit here in preference to the additive rounding). EPS check: 1,232,275/1,107,893,840=1.112 ~= stated 1.11, no swap.

Revenue used here is Net Revenue (16,182,214), i.e. Gross Revenue (18,959,641) net of the difference explained by intra-group/statutory adjustments the filing itself nets before Cost of Sales; Net Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit exactly (16,182,214-10,539,057=5,643,157), confirming Net Revenue is the correct top-line figure to use, not Gross Revenue. operating_profit is a derived subtotal (Gross Profit + Other Operating Income - Distribution Expenses - Administrative Expenses + Other Operating Expenses = 5,643,157+345,502-2,679,901-1,107,238+6,577 = 2,208,097), the closest pre-finance-items subtotal available; this ties to the filing's own 'Profit Before Tax' line of 1,560,826 after deducting Finance Expenses (702,914) and adding Finance Income (55,643): 2,208,097-702,914+55,643=1,560,826. profit_before_tax (2,582,888) is the filing's 'Net Profit before Income Tax', i.e. after adding Share of Associate Company's Profit (1,022,062, mainly LB Finance PLC per the Finance segment note) on top of the 1,560,826 pre-associate PBT -- this associate contribution is roughly 40% of profit_before_tax and is called out separately in the narrative. profit_after_tax (2,109,760) includes a small loss from discontinued operations (-6,921, being the winding-up of Valley View Ceramics LLC and the held-for-sale Lanka Swisstek (Pvt) Ltd within the Lanka Walltiles/Lanka Tiles sub-group) which is already netted into the filing's 'Net Profit for the period' figure used here; profit_after_tax from continuing operations alone was 2,116,681. No column-swap ambiguity was found: every reconciliation above ties exactly to the filing's own printed subtotals, and EPS checks out (1,797,911 attributable profit / 1,107,893,840 shares = Rs.1.623 ~= stated 1.62; prior 1,151,415/1,107,893,840=1.039 ~= stated 1.04).

interim_updates.note_text: RCL Group Net Revenue grew 14.8% YoY to Rs.16,182.2Mn (Q1 FY25/26: Rs.14,096.2Mn), with Gross Profit up faster, +29.1% to Rs.5,643.2Mn, on margin improvement across segments. By segment (external sales): Tiles & Associated Products, the core Lanka Walltiles/Lanka Ceramic tile business and by far the largest, grew 17.5% to Rs.9,657.7Mn with segment PBT more than doubling from Rs.474.3Mn to Rs.975.3Mn (+105.6%); Sanitaryware (Rocell Bathware) PBT swung from Rs.13.0Mn to Rs.141.1Mn (+989%); Aluminium PBT rose 96.1% to Rs.168.5Mn; and Packaging PBT grew 9.8% to Rs.225.9Mn. The derived pre-finance operating profit rose 55.2% to Rs.2,208.1Mn, but net finance cost also rose 9.1% (Rs.647.3Mn vs Rs.593.5Mn) on a larger consolidated borrowings base, leaving the filing's own 'Profit Before Tax' (pre-associate) up 88.2% to Rs.1,560.8Mn. On top of this, Share of Associate Company's Profit -- overwhelmingly LB Finance PLC per the Finance segment note (Rs.980.9Mn of the Rs.1,022.1Mn total, +38.3% YoY) -- added a further Rs.1,022.1Mn (+33.5% YoY), taking Net Profit Before Tax to Rs.2,582.9Mn (+61.9%); the associate contribution alone is about 40% of Group PBT this quarter, so a meaningful share of the reported profit growth is coming from LB Finance's performance rather than RCL's own ceramics/tiles/sanitaryware operations. Tax expense grew even faster than PBT (+84.5% to Rs.466.2Mn), but Net Profit for the Period still grew 70.2% to Rs.2,109.8Mn, helped by discontinued operations (the wind-down of Valley View Ceramics LLC and the held-for-sale disposal of Lanka Swisstek (Pvt) Ltd, within the Lanka Walltiles/Lanka Tiles sub-group) narrowing from a Rs.103.6Mn loss to just a Rs.6.9Mn loss. Basic EPS rose from Rs.1.04 to Rs.1.62 (+55.8%). Operating cash flow was negative, -Rs.1,967.7Mn (vs +Rs.444.4Mn a year earlier), driven by a Rs.1,871.6Mn inventory build and a Rs.1,254.4Mn reduction in other current liabilities.
interim_updates.gaps_note: No QoQ comparison possible: no quarter closer to this one has been collected for RCL -- this is the first financial_statements entry for this symbol. Balance-sheet comparison is to the prior fiscal year-end (31 March 2026) only, per the filing's own presentation and LKAS 34 convention -- there is no same-quarter-last-year (30 June 2025) balance sheet column in this filing, so no true YoY balance-sheet comparison was possible; all balance-sheet figures stored here are point-in-time as at 30 June 2026. This filing does include a discontinued-operations note (Valley View Ceramics LLC wind-down and Lanka Swisstek (Pvt) Ltd held-for-sale, both within the Lanka Walltiles/Lanka Tiles sub-group) of the kind that caused a column-order ambiguity for Lanka Tiles PLC (TILE) earlier this session -- but for RCL itself every subtotal in the P&L, cash flow and segment note ties out exactly with no swap, so no adjustment was needed here; see the notes field on the GROUP financial_statements row for the full reconciliation.
interim_updates.takeaway: Reported profit growth looks very strong (PBT +62%, PAT +70%) but roughly 40% of Group PBT this quarter came from RCL's share of LB Finance PLC's associate profit (Rs.1,022.1Mn) rather than from the tiles/sanitaryware/aluminium manufacturing operations themselves; the manufacturing side's own pre-associate PBT still grew a healthy 88.2%, but net finance cost is rising (+9.1% YoY) and operating cash flow was sharply negative (-Rs.1,967.7Mn) on a large inventory build, so cash generation lagged the reported earnings growth this quarter.

yoy.label: Net Profit Before Tax (incl. Share of Associate)

operational_highlights: Group Net Revenue Rs.16,182.2Mn, up 14.8% YoY; Gross Profit Rs.5,643.2Mn, up 29.1%.
Tiles & Associated Products segment PBT more than doubled to Rs.975.3Mn (from Rs.474.3Mn); Sanitaryware PBT swung from Rs.13.0Mn to Rs.141.1Mn.
Share of Associate Company's Profit (mainly LB Finance PLC) Rs.1,022.1Mn, +33.5% YoY, contributing about 40% of Group PBT.
Net Profit Before Tax Rs.2,582.9Mn (+61.9%); Net Profit for the Period Rs.2,109.8Mn (+70.2%), Basic EPS Rs.1.62 (from Rs.1.04).
Discontinued operations loss narrowed to Rs.6.9Mn (from Rs.103.6Mn) as the Valley View Ceramics LLC wind-down and Lanka Swisstek (Pvt) Ltd disposal near completion.
Net operating cash flow -Rs.1,967.7Mn (vs +Rs.444.4Mn prior year) on a Rs.1,871.6Mn inventory build; net finance cost rose 9.1% YoY to Rs.647.3Mn.
key_drivers: LB Finance PLC (associate) profit contribution of Rs.1,022.1Mn is roughly 40% of Group PBT this quarter -- the single largest driver of reported profit growth outside the core manufacturing segments.
Tiles & Associated Products (Lanka Walltiles/Lanka Ceramic) segment PBT +105.6% YoY (Rs.474.3Mn to Rs.975.3Mn) is the largest driver within the manufacturing operations.
Sanitaryware (Rocell Bathware) swung from a near break-even Rs.13.0Mn PBT to Rs.141.1Mn, the largest percentage mover among segments.
Net finance cost rose 9.1% YoY (Rs.593.5Mn to Rs.647.3Mn) on a larger consolidated borrowings base, partly offsetting the operating profit gains.

_gaps: ebitda: depreciation_amortization not disclosed; EBITDA understated (= operating profit only)
